svg.title: Express observability lab: prom-client metrics and winston-loki logs with Prometheus, Grafana and Loki
svg.desc: An Express CRUD API carries a request counter and a latency histogram labelled by method, route and status (prom-client) and ships logs with winston-loki. Prometheus scrapes the metrics, Loki receives the logs and Grafana queries both; the three run from Docker Compose. The dashboard drawing is illustrative and shows no real values.
